time_horizon: Present tense; policy checked at the October 6, 2026 cutoff.
occurrence: Tom’s Guide headline “ChatGPT is sharing your secrets — keep your chats private by changing this setting” (Andy Sansom, April 26, 2023). The article explains that ChatGPT saved conversations to train its model.

P1.reason: Describes training as disclosure. OpenAI’s stated policy is that eligible chats may be used to improve its models, with limited access by authorized staff and providers; other people see a chat only through a link you share.

P2.reason: Applies to every chat and user, ignoring the training opt-out, Temporary Chat and business accounts, which are excluded from training by default.

W1.reason: Calling every chat a “secret” that is being “shared” adds alarm beyond what the policy describes.

W2.reason: Ordinary shorthand for the company’s practice; the mechanism problem is scored above.
